## PRB1.6. Cost-efficiency {#prb1.6.-cost-efficiency .Heading-2-ER}

- The real en route actual unit cost (AUC) Union-wide was -2.8% lower than the determined unit cost (DUC).

- Real en route actual costs were -1.1% below determined costs, while actual service units were +1.8% higher than the determined service units.

- The en route actual unit cost incurred by airspace users (AUCU) was -2.1% lower than the DUC, mainly stemming from other revenues.
